name: lvid.know/lecture/videommmu
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (dataset); videos remain their creators'
notes: 255 lecture videos, 500 questions, most with 10 options. The input is the video with its complete audio track (median 458 s, longest 2,028 s); models that do not take audio are unsupported on it. Known limit of the reference run: Jev-Omni with the full audio scores 26.4 % (61 % on items with under 3 minutes of audio, but 11-12 % beyond 7.5 minutes, where its answers collapse onto the seventh option); the 2 items with 2,028 s of audio exceed a 48 GB card and are recorded as rejected.
